name: reminder
description: Create reminders for tasks/events with a deadline, or check which reminders are currently due. Call with action='set' and a clear task_name plus an ISO 8601 deadline when the user wants to be reminded of something. Call with action='check' to see what's currently due.

action.description: Whether to create a new reminder ('set') or check what's currently due ('check').

task_name.description: Short, clean description of what the reminder is for (e.g. 'Exam', 'Submit report'). Required for action='set'. Strip filler words and time phrases - just the task itself.

deadline.description: The deadline as a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. '2026-06-21T22:00:00'. Required for action='set'. Resolve relative phrases like 'tomorrow', 'in 2 hours', or a weekday name into an actual timestamp using the current time you've been given in the system prompt - do not pass the raw phrase through.
